message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. Before slugifying, it decomposes the title (NFD) and strips the combining accent marks, so "è" becomes "e" instead of being dropped.

I didn't edit `vendor/slugify`, because its header and `vendor/README.md` say never to edit vendored code by hand.

`src/shop/product-url.js` uses the same vendored slugify, so product names with accents will still lose letters. I left it alone because you asked about blog posts; the same one-line normalization would fix it if you want it.
